name: balor
damage_resistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical weapons

special_abilities.name: death throes
special_abilities.desc: When the balor dies, it explodes, and each creature within 30 feet of it must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 70 (20d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in that area that aren't being worn or carried, and it destroys the balor's weapons.

special_abilities.name: fire aura
special_abilities.desc: At the start of each of the balor's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the balor or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 10 (3d6) fire damage.

special_abilities.name: magic resistance
special_abilities.desc: The balor has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

special_abilities.name: magic weapons
special_abilities.desc: The balor's weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The balor makes two attacks: one with its longsword and one with its whip.

actions.name: longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) lightning damage. If the balor scores a critical hit, it rolls damage dice three times, instead of twice.

actions.name: whip
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 30 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) fire damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pulled up to 25 feet toward the balor.

actions.name: teleport
actions.desc: The balor magically teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

lore:
The Balor is a titan of the Abyssal depths, a creature woven from primordial shadow and living flame. They reside within the sulfurous rifts of the lower planes, where the very air bleeds heat. Unlike beasts driven by hunger, the Balor hunts for the ecstasy of absolute dominion. It wields a whip of white-hot fire, dragging the screaming into an embrace of incinerating heat before delivering the final stroke with a blade of lightning and jagged iron.

In local folklore, the Balor is whispered of as the "Calamity’s Herald." Rural folk believe that when the earth tremors without cause, a Balor is testing the boundaries of its cage. They are the generals of the pit, commanders of the damned who view mortals as mere tinder for their eternal pyre. Legend warns that a Balor’s spite outlives its flesh; upon their defeat, they expire in a vengeful conflagration that scours the land for leagues. To face one is not a mere battle, but a confrontation with the inevitable end of all things.
